steps.template_en: Neyman-Pearson Lemma: For H₀:θ=θ₀ vs H₁:θ=θ₁, MOST POWERFUL test at level α rejects when L(θ₀)/L(θ₁)<c. Threshold c chosen so P(reject|H₀)=α. Foundation of optimal testing.
steps.template_zh: Neyman-Pearson引理：水平α的最优势检验当L(θ₀)/L(θ₁)<c时拒绝H₀。c选择使P(拒绝|H₀)=α。最优检验基础。

steps.template_en: X₁,...,Xₙ~N(μ,1). H₀:μ=0 vs H₁:μ=μ₁>0. LR: L(0)/L(μ₁)=exp[-μ₁Σxᵢ+nμ₁²/2]. Reject when Σxᵢ>k → X̄>k/n. Most powerful test rejects for LARGE X̄.
steps.template_zh: N(μ,1): H₀:μ=0 vs H₁:μ=μ₁>0。LR: 当X̄大时拒绝。最优势检验。

steps.template_en: t-test: H₀: μ=μ₀ vs H₁: μ≠μ₀. t=(X̄-μ₀)/(S/√n)~t_{n-1} under H₀. Reject when |t|>t_{n-1,α/2}. A LIKELIHOOD RATIO TEST.
p-value = SMALLEST α where we reject H₀. t-test: p=2×P(T_{n-1}>|t_obs|). p≠P(H₀|data).
NP lemma → THEORETICAL gold standard. Practice: LRTs (asymptotically optimal). Simple vs simple: NP exactly most powerful. Composite: need UMP tests (only special cases).
steps.template_zh: NP引理→理论金标准。实践：LRT(渐近最优)。简单vs简单：NP恰好最优势。复合：需UMP检验。

steps.template_en: Testing ASYMMETRIC: we control P(Type I)=α but H₀ gets 'benefit of the doubt.' Failing to reject ≠ H₀ true. 'Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.'
steps.template_zh: 检验不对称：控制P(I类)=α但H₀获'怀疑的好处。'没能拒绝≠H₀真。'没有证据≠证据不存在。'
